notes: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-16 — DO NOT PUBLISH TO THIS REGISTRY. The contract at registry_address predates the epochKey change and has no epochSequence mapping, so it cannot enforce one report per epoch and its runtime bytecode no longer matches what this repository builds. It is refused by deployment_state, which is the only thing that actually refuses it: preflight compares deployed code against the digest THIS MANIFEST RECORDS, and this manifest records the obsolete registry's own digest, so preflight agrees with it. An earlier note here claimed preflight would refuse it; that was false. It published nothing, so there is no history to migrate; a replacement deployment is an owner gate that has not been requested. Reconstructed on 2026-08-15 after the deploy script's manifest write failed on a relative path, leaving the registry live with no record of it. No second deployment was made. READ FROM THE CHAIN: registry_address (derived from deployer and nonce 0, confirmed by eth_getCode), registry_runtime_bytecode_sha256, deployment_block, chain_id, publisher_identity_address (publisherIdentity()), and the creation transaction bdd1d330764eb6f38d137efd627083230e81447ef7b4b5436b71bddafa4196dd. RECONSTRUCTED CONFIGURATION, not chain facts: rpc_url, confirmations, max_fee_wei, operations_address and reporting_keys — these were the deploy inputs and the chain does not attest them. Saying every field was read from the deployment was too broad.
